description: Source code for the 'podtopologylabels' admission plugin in Kubernetes, handling topology label copying during pod and binding admission processes.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: Main admission plugin struct handling topology label logic, including node lister and feature gate inspection.

methods.name: InspectFeatureGates
methods.description: Checks if the PodTopologyLabelsAdmission feature is enabled.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeInformerFactory
methods.description: Sets the node informer factory and lister.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates that the plugin has been properly initialized.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Main admission method handling pod and binding admission logic.

methods.name: admitBinding
methods.description: Handles topology label copying during pod binding.

methods.name: admitPod
methods.description: Handles topology label copying during pod creation/update.

methods.name: topologyLabelsForNodeName
methods.description: Retrieves topology labels for a given node.

methods.name: mergeLabels
methods.description: Merges label maps, overwriting existing keys.

methods.name: isTopologyLabel
methods.description: Checks if a label key is a topology label based on explicit labels.

methods.name: shouldAdmit
methods.description: Determines if the admission request should be processed by this plugin.
